transcript: Here's how perfectionism is fucking you over. A photography professor divided his class in two. The left-hand side was tasked with taking 100 photos, the right-hand side were tasked with taking one excellent photo. Upon submission, the professor was surprised to discover that the 100 group had higher quality submissions than the excellent photo group, even though they weren't being marked on quality. Perfectionism didn't do shit, and repetition won out. Just doing the thing repeatedly, shittily, will produce better results than stressing about perfecting something you don't have the skill to perfect. But you know what would give you the skill? Reper-fucking-tition! I'm going that way if you want to come.
